method: Core commitments: statements on which every sincere adherent of an ideology must be on one side. side is the sign of the raw answer (+1 agree, -1 disagree) to the statement as worded; the item key is not applied. frame I checks the ideal-system answer; both also checks here and now. A decisive contradiction (|answer| >= 2 on the wrong side) rules the ideology out. Not yet coded: this list is empty until the coding workflow lands.
